input: Owner brief: build an autonomous AI nutrition tracking system (iPhone Camera photos -> AI vision -> Apple Health -> bidirectional ChatGPT), research platform limits, ADR, MVP, tests, docs.
task: Owner brief: autonomous photo-to-Apple-Health nutrition agent with bidirectional ChatGPT

errors.what: First push failed five CI checks: README lacked the live-page link (venture_live_links.py), no launch date (launched.mjs), .swift files would be published, no tab icon (favicons.py), and the new page had no sibling link (siblings.mjs).
errors.fix: Added the link, launch date and favicon; moved ios/ under mobile/ (excluded from publishing); linked cheap-meal-plan-optimizer <-> photo-nutrition-agent with page tests.

doc_friction.issue: The new-venture publishing gates (live link in README, launched.mjs --write, favicons.py --fix, a sibling link, mobile/ for native sources) are not listed in one place; each surfaced only as a separate CI failure after the push. run_venture_tests.py's page checks did not catch any of them.
run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes ran for over ten minutes and blocks editing tracked files while it runs; the faster path was to read the CI logs once checks started.

deviations.why: §5d usage counting: no telemetry in a self-hosted health-data product or on its static page; privacy is the product's core promise.
deviations.did: No usage counting; privacy.md states there is none.

deviations.why: System rules for this session forbid model identifiers in pushed artifacts, so the run record's model field is left null.
The brief's personal body stats (age, weight, DEXA values) would be published in a public repository.
deviations.did: Kept them out of the tree; targets are runtime settings or a git-ignored config.local.json.

notes: Outcome partial: the server, MCP/OAuth and docs are complete and tested (39 tests in the venture, sibling test in cheap-meal-plan-optimizer); the iOS agent was written without an Apple toolchain and never compiled; the live vision-model call and ChatGPT Plus write-tool eligibility are unverified (help.openai.com and developers.openai.com unreachable through the proxy). Local checks: run_venture_tests.py photo-nutrition-agent cheap-meal-plan-optimizer ok; clauses.mjs ok; check_posts.py ok; siblings.mjs --check ok; favicons ok; venture_live_links ok; unwired_checks 281/283 before fixes, the transition.json one fixed, check_third_party.py fails on research/sensing-selfcal (not this PR). run_workflow_locally --for-changes: agent-permission-harness 5/5, pages.yml steps ok until it was voided by the CI fixes; GitHub CI is the verification for the rest.
